newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT OTAGO 45-28.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT OTAGO 45-28.

text.p: The Auckland Blues beat the Otago Highlanders 45-28 (halftime 7-15) in a Super 12 match at Carisbrook on Saturday.
Auckland - Tries: Jeremy Stanley (2), Robin Brooke (2), Joeli Vidiri, Ofisa Tonu'u, Lee Stensness; Conversions: Adrian Cashmore, Carlos Spencer (4).
Otago - Tries: Taine Randell, Anton Oliver, Romi Ropati, Josh Kronfeld; Conversion: Tony Brown; Penalties: Brown, Brendan Laney.
